text.p: Guarantee Life Cos Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering up to 1,835,828 shares of common stock.

Over the next several years, 1,000,000 shares will be offered to employees under its Guarantee Life Insurance Co's Thrift Savings Plan and Trust. In addition, 835,828 common shares will be offered over time to officers and directors under an incentive plan and directors stock incentive plan.

For the first time, beginning January 1, participants in the thrift savings plan will have the opportunity to purchase common stock. The company's matching contributions will paid in shares of common stock.
The common stock to be offered to employees under this plan will be purchased from time to time in the open market and will not be purchased from the company.
